title: Foresight
paragraphs: “Why don’t we head to the weapon shop next? The old man there was worried about Naofumi.”
“Good idea. He’s got quite a collection of rare weapons. It’s definitely worth a visit.”
With that, we headed to the weapon shop, where the old man let Father copy some shields.
“You guys have been through a lot, huh? But man, I was shocked. The Queen herself came to my shop.”
“Did you manage to sell her enough? Make sure to give me a cut of the profit later.”
Father was chatting casually with the weapon shop’s old man.
“Nah, I didn’t sell her anything. Anyway, you lot should buy something too. I’ll even throw in a little discount.”
“Then, should we buy something for Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan?”
“Yes! Cough!”
The Big Sis’ friend raised her hand energetically but immediately coughed afterward. Meanwhile, the Big Sis herself kept her forced smile, though she was trembling slightly.
“Uh… is that girl okay?”
“Hmm…”
“W-What do you mean?”
Big Sister responded as if she was offended. But her voice had a hint of fear in it.
“Just a little worried.”
“The darkness in this country runs deep.”
Fiancée closed her eyes quietly and nodded.
“What’s the budget? Well, judging by their looks, they’re probably beginners, so…”

As expected, the old man at the weapon shop was giving Big Sister and her friend a lesson on using daggers, just like he did when he taught Keel. Big Sister and her friend seemed a little excited after Father bought them weapons and armor. That said, Big Sister’s eyes still looked slightly unfocused and uneasy.
“Raphtalia-chan.”
“Y-Yes!?”
“It’s okay to use it for cooking or whatever too, you know?”
“Yes. Rifana-chan, are you okay?”
“Yeah. I’m a little scared, but I’ll do my best.”
They seem close. It’s always good to see people getting along.
“Well, we’ve taken care of most of our errands. What should we do next?”
“We still haven’t bought the Filolials!”
Father and the others were already giving off the vibe that they were ready to head home, so I protested. That’s right. We must purchase the Filolials.
“Oh, right.”
“Didn’t we already buy one?”
“One isn’t enough!”
Kuro-chan was rare, so I only bought that one.
“It’s different from the Filolials I usually buy after looping.”
Filo-tan is not with the monster merchant. And I need to introduce Sakura-chan, the Filolial who will protect Father. This time, I’m sure she’ll protect the ladies too.
“Then, next is buying the Filolials who are Motoyasu-kun’s companions? Shall we go?”
“Yes, indeed!”
I took Father and the others through the portal to the Filolial breeder.
“Wow… such a big Filolial ranch… I think this place is… very famous.”
Oh, Fiancée knows how famous this place is. As usual, I purchased the eggs of Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan.
“Father, this is Sakura-chan’s egg… the Filolial who will protect you.”
“Then, today’s plans are more or less on track?”
“Once the portal’s cooldown is over, we’ll go to Zeltbull to look for Big Sister’s sister.”
“Got it. But I guess we shouldn’t stay out drinking too late.”
“We need to avoid drawing too much attention.”
“Yeah. I just want to get stronger quickly so we can move around freely.”
Fiancée was leaning against the fence, waving at the Filolials.
“Um… can we watch the Filolials a little longer?”
“I think it’s fine since there’s a cooldown. Oh, there’s a petting area over there. Want to check it out? Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan should come too.”
“Yes.”
“A ranch, huh? We had one in the village too.”
“Yeah!”
Father and the others were relaxing near the Filolial ranch, each doing their own thing.
As we chatted and passed the time, the cooldown ended, and it was time to leave.
“Portal Spear, here we go!”
Just before teleporting… I casually took the egg hidden in my pocket and tossed it into the stream behind me.
Hmph… Rival must have possessed the egg through my spear, but that won’t work on me.

There’s no way I’m letting you take Father’s innocence! But since it’s parasitizing the spear, if I kill it, it might just possess another egg. So, after it possesses the egg, throwing it away like this ensures it loses contact with us. Now, all I can do is pray that we don’t cross paths again.
Hahaha! I laughed to myself—right at that moment.
“So, what kind of person is Sadeena? According to Motoyasu-kun, she’s really strong and takes good care of people.”
“Sadeena-neesan? She’s kind and really strong, right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yeah. She loves alcohol.”
“I see. I hope we can meet her.”
Father’s words made Big Sister and her friend nod. Yes, that’s right. We’ll surely meet her soon.
“What does she look like?”
“Um… she’s an aquatic beastman. I think it was a Luka species?”
“I’m not really sure…”
“You mean the appearance of Big Sister’s sister?”
“Yeah. Motoyasu-kun, you know her, right? What’s she like?”
“In her demi-human form, she’s about the same height as Father, and I’d say she has a good figure. In her beast form, she’s an orca.”
At that, Big Sister and her friend tilted their heads.
“Did Sadeena-neesan ever have a demi-human form?”
“Hmm…? I don’t think so.”
“Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan say she doesn’t, but what about it?”
Oh? Do Big Sister and her friend not know?
“Now that I think about it, she did tend to stay in her beast form most of the time. I heard that she rarely took her demi-human form around people she was familiar with.”
In the previous loop, she stayed in her demi-human form quite often. There might have been a reason, but I never heard it.
“Hmm… so, she’s coming to this tavern, and I should just wait and recruit her, right?”
“That’s right.”
“Though, wouldn’t it be better to go look for her instead of waiting?”
“That’s true as well. Shall I go search for her?”
“Can’t we use the Hero’s authority or the Queen’s orders to look for her?”
Oh, that’s a good idea. As expected of Father!
“Well, part of the reason we’re waiting here is to gather companions before taking on the activation event. I hope we can meet up with her…”
We need to get stronger quickly.
“When do we depart?”
“It’s best to leave as soon as we take custody of Keel and the other slaves from the monster merchant. Otherwise, waiting here would be pointless.”

Once I finish raising Yuki-chan and the others who will hatch tomorrow, leveling up Father and the others will be a breeze. If possible, we should make use of the activation to strengthen them while also raising their potential.
“Got it. Then I’ll talk to the tavern master and tell him that if someone named Sadeena comes by, there’s someone looking for her under Raphtalia-chan and the others’ names.”
Saying that, Father casually approached the tavern master to ask. Being fearless is one of Father’s strengths.
